preconditions.expression: all(1 <= si <= n for si in s)
preconditions.description: All plate sizes are integers between 1 and n (inclusive).
The number of plates is exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(si != sj for i, si in enumerate(s) for j, sj in enumerate(s) if i != j)

preconditions.description: a and b are integers between 1 and n (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if any(solution_exists(s, a, b) for _ in range(1)) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Outputs 'YES' if there exists a sequence of operations to arrange plates in increasing order in the dryer, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= tj <= 2 for line in stdout.splitlines()[2:] for tj, _ in [line.split()]) if 'YES' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES', each operation line contains a valid operation type (1 or 2).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= cj <= max(a, b) for line in stdout.splitlines()[2:] for _, cj in [line.split()]) if 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES', each operation line contains a valid count (1 to a for type 1, 1 to b for type 2).
If 'YES', the output includes the number of operations followed by the operations themselves.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= a if int(line.split()[0]) == 1 else 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= b for line in stdout.splitlines()[2:]) if 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES', each operation's count respects the constraints of a or b based on operation type.
